scope: All readable text in both supplied books; 622 structured 2016–2022 cases, including their inquiry findings. 14 confirmed fire cases form the fire briefing subset.
limitations: Historical accident reports, not a current mine inspection or a current regulation register.
Scanned cover/short pages are listed in the ingestion manifest; numerical tables can lose layout during PDF extraction.
The retrieval model is fitted to these documents; a separately configured language model generates grounded answers.
Retrieval scores are similarity signals, not probabilities of fire or factual correctness.
